payload.title: Type Creative — blurb, script, or thumbnail attached to a Deliverable
payload.description:
Parked type spec — do not implement. Not in progress.

## Type: Creative

Blurb, script, or thumbnail. Attached to a Deliverable (or Slot). **Can fail independently of the Slot** (bad take, wrong crop, rejected angle) without skipping the placement clock until Publicist replaces it.

Useful as the copy/art attached to LandingPage, Video, ImageSet, SocialCopy, or PpcCopy.

## Out of scope

- Not the Slot
- Not the SharePayload (that is the packed, channel-ready bundle)
- No implementation from this issue
